description: This file defines the class ColumnClusteredPlotAreaRenderer, a specialized renderer for clustered column charts in the PDFsharp charting library. It calculates positions and dimensions of columns and determines if data points are within range.

classes.name: ColumnClusteredPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for clustered column plot areas, drawing columns side by side and calculating their positions.

methods.name: CalcColumns
methods.description: Calculates position, width, and height of each column in the chart based on series data and axis scales.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Checks if a given y-value is within the yMin and yMax range.
